:::{#def-cv-estimate-indexed}
#### Cross-validation estimate of a named procedure

Let a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$, indexed by $I$,
be divided into [folds](#def-folds) $\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{k}$.
The **cross-validation estimate of procedure** $g$ on $\trainset$,
$\cvestof{k}{g}\paren{\trainset}$,
is the [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate)
computed with [fold-out rules](#def-fold-out-rule) that $g$ produces from $\trainset$:

$$
\cvestof{k}{g}\paren{\trainset} \eqdef \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i \in I}
\sqf{g\paren{x_i; \paren{(x_{i'}, y_{i'})}_{i' \in I \setminus \fold{\foldof{i}}}} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-cv-estimate-indexed}

:::
